sloka: इदं च पुरुषव्याघ्रः श्रीमान् दाशरथिः स्वयम् ।अङ्गुलीयमभिज्ञानमदात्तुभ्यं यशस्विनि ।। ५.५८.९७ ।।।।
transliteration: idaṁ ca puruṣavyāghraḥ śrīmān dāśarathiḥ svayam ।aṅgulīyamabhijñānamadāttubhyaṁ yaśasvini ।। 5.58.97 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O glorious lady the tiger among men, the illustrious son of Dasaratha himself sent this ring to you as a taken of identity.
